checks.detail: 90 of 90 checks: every program compiled with gcc 13.3 (-std=c17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror) or parsed by Python 3.13, and every terminal session on the page replayed with its output compared line by line (deliberately broken examples are compiled and their real error messages compared).

printf-to-puts replacement, constant-folded loop at -O2, symbol tables, dynamic and static linking, bytecode (Python 3.13), write system calls and system-call counts all observed on the test machine (x86-64 Linux, gcc 13.3, Python 3.13). Timings (C about 0.2 s, Python about 4.5 s, -O2 about 0.003 s) measured there and labelled as such.
Preprocessed line count corrected from 820 to 821; the C/Python polyglot's first line could not be a C comment, so its file name is now given in the text instead.
